meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

copy.tagline: 把数据变成有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常需要向别人解释数据背后的含义
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain the meaning behind data to others

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你把数据变成有说服力的故事。它会自动套用叙事结构（如问题-解决方案、趋势对比），生成带图表建议的演示文稿或报告，并突出关键洞察和行动建议。
howto.when: 当你需要向高管、投资者或非技术团队展示数据分析结果，或撰写数据驱动的报告时触发。

say.text: 帮我用问题-解决方案框架分析客户流失数据。
为Q4业绩做一个趋势故事，突出关键转折点。
say.note: Claude 会按时间线组织数据，展示变化和关键洞察。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you turn data into compelling narratives. It automatically applies story structures (e.g., problem-solution, trend comparison), generates presentation slides or reports with chart suggestions, and highlights key insights and action items.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to present analytics to executives, investors, or non-technical audiences, or create data-driven reports.

say_en.text: Analyze customer churn data using the problem-solution framework.
Create a trend story for Q4 performance, highlighting key turning points.
say_en.note: Claude organizes data chronologically, showing changes and key insights.
